title: Bandeja Paisa
description: Bandeja Paisa is a dish from Colombia featuring white rice, kidney beans, arepa flour, ground beef. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used. A simplified bandeja paisa plate of rice, beans, arepa, plantain, meat and egg, rather than every customary accompaniment.

steps.instruction: Rinse the rice, add the listed water, stock, coconut milk and aromatics as specified, cover and cook gently for about 24 minutes until tender and the liquid absorbs.
Soak the dried beans in ample clean cold water for about 420 minutes, drain and discard the soaking water; cook fully in fresh water.
Cook the listed ingredients in simmering water for about 90 minutes until tender; drain well if necessary.
Mix the corn flour with the measured water and salt until a soft cohesive, non-sticky masa forms. Rest covered for about 10 minutes; this gluten-free dough does not become elastic like wheat dough.
Heat the pan over medium heat, shape or spoon out portions, and fry for about 12 minutes total until golden on both sides and fully cooked.
Heat the pan over medium heat, shape or spoon out portions, and fry for about 16 minutes total until golden on both sides and fully cooked.
Heat the pan over medium heat, shape or spoon out portions, and fry for about 12 minutes total until golden on both sides and fully cooked.
Arrange the fully cooked and prepared parts of the dish on plates or in the intended serving vessel, adding the listed toppings or accompaniments just before serving.
